lineage.source: net-new in-tree exact representation/dataflow premise over the retained H5L ordered body; no external device body copied
lineage.kernel_lineage_audit: four pre-existing documented Qwen/PARO drifts only

target.label: WPF-H5O exact factorized-Q5 plane
target.control: H5L expands every Q5_K block to 256 exact F32 weights, then the retained weight-major ordered consumer loads those values
target.candidate: a separate producer stores 256 unsigned quant bytes plus eight exact scale coefficients and eight exact minimum coefficients per Q5_K block; a separate consumer reconstructs each existing F32 weight bit before executing H5L's unchanged per-output fmaf, wave reduction, serial wave sum, and store
target.arithmetic_contract: every candidate reconstructed F32 weight bit must equal the retained raw-Q5-to-F32 producer before the unchanged H5L matrix fmaf/reduction sequence; no Q8_1, WMMA, SGEMM, reassociation, approximate repair, or changed output rounding
target.fallback: retained H5L F32-plane weight-major role, or retained H5G for its existing small roles, on every shape/key/registration/backend miss

logical_traffic_model.scope: actual direct-M512 eight-shape/235-call Q5 inventory, rows512; source-level bytes only, not measured HBM/L2 traffic or a performance forecast
caveats: The model counts logical workgroup loads and writes; H5L's adjacent row groups intentionally reuse F32 tiles through cache, so it is not a physical bandwidth claim.
The candidate adds one exact weight-reconstruction operation sequence per weight per workgroup; actual event and synchronized-wall timing decides whether smaller traffic outweighs added ALU.
No end-to-end throughput, HBM bandwidth, or parity improvement is claimed by this target-selection artifact.
